Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must be available for Android and iOS devices.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-009: The application must be deployable and fully functional on both Android and iOS mobile operating systems.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-009 fully captures the original requirement's meaning: availability on both Android and iOS devices. It even strengthens it slightly by stating deployable and fully functional, but the original intent is completely preserved.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: Once the app is started, its startup time must be less than or equal to two seconds.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-001: The application must be fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-001 directly matches the startup performance constraint of <= 2 seconds after launch. 'Fully loaded and ready to use' is a faithful restatement of startup completion.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The display of live streams in the app must comply with the respective broadcasting rights in the country.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement covers compliance of live stream display with country-specific broadcasting rights. This legal/geographical constraint is missing entirely.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: Users personal data must be stored in compliance with GDPR.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-008: All personal user data must be processed in compliance with the GDPR.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-008 is close but not complete. The original specifically requires that users' personal data be stored in compliance with GDPR, while the generated requirement broadens this to 'processed' in compliance with GDPR. Although storage is part of processing, the explicit storage requirement is not preserved verbatim and the focus shifts slightly.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The apps session management must ensure that logged-in users remain logged in until they actively log out.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement addresses session persistence or the constraint that users remain logged in until they explicitly log out.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must function reliably even with limited network connectivity.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-002: The application must function reliably even with limited network coverage, providing graceful degradation of features.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-002 clearly captures the original requirement that the app function reliably under limited connectivity. The added note about graceful degradation is compatible elaboration, not a contradiction.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: When the number of users reaches up to 100,000 simultaneously, the app must remain stable.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-004: The application must support at least 100,000 simultaneous users without any loss of performance.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-004 substantially overlaps with the original, but it changes the precise quality criterion. The original requires stability at up to 100,000 simultaneous users, while the generated requirement imposes a stronger and different condition: no performance loss. Stability and performance are related but not semantically identical.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: After release, a support process must be established to quickly resolve technical issues.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-006: The application must undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to identify and resolve technical problems early.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-006 does not preserve the temporal and procedural intent. The original requires a support process after release for rapid issue resolution. The generated requirement shifts this to before release and combines it with testing, which is materially different.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: After six months of operation, feedback and user reviews must be analyzed to further develop the app.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-007: User feedback and app reviews must be continuously evaluated to improve app functionality.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-007 captures the idea of analyzing feedback and reviews for improvement, but it omits the original timing constraint 'after six months of operation.' Replacing a specific milestone with continuous evaluation changes the requirement semantics.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must include an integrated live ticker module.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement specifies that the app must include an integrated live ticker module.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must include a user interface that is an integral part of the app.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement explicitly states that the app must include a user interface as an integral part of the app.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The live ticker module must be connected to the user interface through its own interface to display data.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement covers the architectural interface connection between the live ticker module and the user interface for data display.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The live ticker module must communicate with an external server via an API to retrieve current match data.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement states that the live ticker module communicates with an external server via API to fetch current match data.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The external server must provide the app with current match data.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement captures the requirement that the external server provide current match data to the app.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The external server must be physically located outside the app environment.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement includes the deployment/location constraint that the external server be physically outside the app environment.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must include a user management system.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement mentions inclusion of a user management system.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The user management system must be connected to the user interface via its own interface.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement captures the architectural connection between the user management system and the user interface via a dedicated interface.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The app must include a notification system.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement specifies that the app must include a notification system.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: All modules and the user interface must be fixed components of the app.
Metrics.generated_requirements: NFR-005: All application modules and the user interface must remain consistent and operational even if the external server providing data is updated.
Metrics.explanation: NFR-005 mentions modules and the user interface, but it changes the meaning. The original states that all modules and the UI are fixed components of the app, an architectural composition requirement. The generated requirement instead discusses consistency and operability during external server updates.

Metrics.ground_truth_requirement: The connection to the external server must be designed flexibly.
Metrics.explanation: No generated requirement addresses the architectural/design quality that the connection to the external server be flexible.
